THIS is another great example of why we're building a new model owned by the artists and the audience. 

They all act like #MeToo was a good thing and a cleansing, but it's business as usual.

Looks like one of the worst predators in Hollywood (ahem @Nickelodeon), FAR worse than Harvey, may finally get some karma. 

Ole Nick walked him out the backdoor to ride off into the sunset once the #MeToo movement started.
